newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy invites Zaire and Rwanda to talk in Rome.
newsitem.headline: Italy invites Zaire and Rwanda to talk in Rome.

text.p: Italy said on Wednesday that Zaire and Rwanda, neighbouring countries apparently moving closer to war, would be able to meet on the fringes of a United Nations food summit in Rome next month.

Rino Serri, a foreign ministry under-secretary, said Italy had offered to host the meeting during the November 13-17 summit which an estimated 100 heads of state and government are expected to attend.
Serri told a Senate commission that Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini would invite the two countries "to open an immediate, substantial and swift dialogue."
Serri said Italy was not proposing to mediate in the crisis but was offering an opportunity for talks.
Zaire and Rwanda engaged in a second day of cross-border artillery exchanges on Wednesday as hundreds of thousands of refugees fled ethnic fighting near the border in eastern Zaire.
